summary: cisco.ise is unmaintained and will be removed from Ansible 12 unless maintained, but it can still be installed with ansible-galaxy afterward.
questions: Is cisco.ise being removed from the Ansible package?
How can I still use cisco.ise after it's removed?

answer_card.title: cisco.ise deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `cisco.ise` is unmaintained and will be removed from Ansible 12 unless someone maintains it. After that, install it with `ansible-galaxy collection install cisco.ise`.
